BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of Life.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of Life.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of Life.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of Life.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cell Structure and Specialisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
